 A throuple, a divorce and some familiar faces: Your guide to the 'Mormon Wives' of Orange County
 From Aspyn Ovard's unconventional romance to Jen Affleck's split, here's what to know about Hulu's new spinoff and its internet-famous moms.
 Neia Balao , Taryn Ryder Updated Thu, November 12, 2026 at 9:40 PM UTC 7 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. The Mormon Wives franchise is officially in Orange County. (Photo illustration: Yahoo News; photo: Disney) Your group chat just found its latest binge. Hulu dropped the entire first season of The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County on Thursday. Following a new crop of young moms, the SoCal spinoff of the hugely successful reality series offers audiences a candid look at their complicated lives, from navigating personal beliefs and bombshell discoveries to healing from divorce and entering an unconventional romance. 
 With the exception of OG Jen Affleck, who relocated from Utah to California for the spinoff, the Orange County cast is new to the Mormon Wives universe — but that doesn't mean you haven't heard of them. Aspyn Ovard , a mom of three daughters, got her start on YouTube as a beloved lifestyle influencer in the 2010s; Bobbi Althoff found fame as the awkward podcaster whose interview with Drake went viral; and Avery Woods, a former pediatric ICU nurse, now hosts a podcast on Alex Cooper's Unwell Network. 
 Still have questions? Here's what to know about the new Mormon Wives . 
 Note: Some spoilers ahead! 
 How does 'Mormon Wives: OC' differ from the OG?
 Briana Davis, Aspyn Ovard, Salomé Andrea and Bobbi Althoff.
 (Ashley Rose/Disney) Its California backdrop isn't the spinoff's only major difference. While the OG Mormon Wives introduced audiences to Utah's #MomTok group as they dealt with the fallout of a swinging scandal, the Orange County version immediately dives into the crew's differing ideological views. Case in point? McCall DaPron is considered a more "trad-wife" Mormon , while Althoff isn't Mormon at all.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "With the Utah girlies, everyone was kind of on the same page when it came to where we were all at with our careers from the start. We're all breadwinners. Whereas with this group, there's a huge divide," Affleck said in a recent interview , noting that the group includes both influencers and stay-at-home moms. "And then definitely a huge divide when it comes to belief."  
 The connections to Utah go beyond Jen
 (From left): Madison Bontempo, Avery Woods, Ovard, Jen Affleck, Althoff, McCall DaPron, Ashleigh Pease and Andrea.
 (Maya Dehlin/Disney) Affleck gives viewers a familiar face, but McCall DaPron also has a family connection to the original cast. Her sister is Mayci Neeley, whose experience helped shape DaPron's expectations. "My sister had such a great experience filming and making friendships on the show," DaPron told Yahoo. "I kind of thought that I was going to jump in and kind of form friendships quicker than I did." Instead, she says, it took almost the entire filming process to build those bonds. 
 Woods also knew women from the original cast before their series began and got some frank advice from Jessi Ngatikaura. "Just be prepared. Things will be brought up from your past," Woods recalled being told. "There are no secrets you're going to be able to keep."
 From divorce to a viral throuple 
 Ovard with Briana and Billy Davis.
 (Ashley Rose/Disney) Even if you weren't religiously keeping up with The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County cast, you probably heard rumblings of a viral throuple that's captivated the internet. In March 2025, a year after she filed for divorce from her ex-husband Parker Ferris, Ovard confirmed that she had entered a throuple with a married couple. The lifestyle influencer is in a relationship with Briana and Billy Davis. Ovard, who came out as bisexual in 2024, said she had never envisioned herself in a " three-person dynamic " until she found herself in one. 
 "There's a lot of different arcs of my life that are shared on the show," Ovard told E! News . "But I'm excited to be representation of a different kind of relationship." 
 Advertisement Advertisement Ovard said that audiences will likely be "a little bit underwhelmed" by how normal their polyamorous relationship actually is.
 "I'm very curious to kind of see what people will say because I think that I've seen some crazy theories, and it's just not that crazy of a thing," she added.
 Jen Affleck's divorce, explained
 Affleck.
 (Maya Dehlin/Disney) Viewers already know Affleck from the original Mormon Wives , where tensions in her marriage to Zac Affleck played out onscreen. On the OC spinoff, she says she discovered more than $100,000 was missing from their bank account and confronted him. She alleges he spent all of their money for online poker or cryptocurrency investments, despite her objections. 
 On Nov. 3. Jen filed for divorce from Zac after seven years of marriage while pregnant with their fourth child. "All I can say is that it's been a really hard week," she told Yahoo two days later. "I hope that — pray for my co-parenting relationship and that everything can be cordial and we can move forward as a team." As for what she wants viewers to understand as they watch this season, she said: "Just me sharing everything and being super vulnerable, and it's all real and raw and my — yeah, just my real life."
 What else do I need to know about the cast? 
 The cast of The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County. 
 (Ashley Rose/Disney) It can be challenging to keep up with all nine of the Orange County Mormon Wives . Here's a quick rundown of the crew, including a few deets about each of the women: 
 Aspyn Ovard, 30
 Where you might recognize her from: A content creator on YouTube , Instagram and TikTok , with a combined  5.3 million followers. 
 Relationship status: Ovard has been in a throuple with married couple Briana and Billy Davis since 2024. They went public with their relationship in March 2025. She also shares three daughters with her ex-husband, Parker Ferris. 
 Jen Affleck, 27 
 Where you might recognize her from: An original Secret Lives of Mormon Wives cast member and part of the viral #MomTok group. Affleck also competed on Season 34 of Dancing With the Stars.  
 Relationship status: Affleck made headlines when it was announced that she filed for divorce from her husband, Zac Affleck, in November 2026, while pregnant with their fourth child. 
 Bobbi Althoff, 28 
 Where you might recognize her from: Host of The Really Good Podcast , on which has interviewed artists including Drake, Offset, Sexyy Red, Lil Yachty and Teddy Swims. Althoff has a combined 12.8 million followers on TikTok and Instagram . 
 Relationship status: Althoff has been in a relationship with basketball player Tyler Hawkins since November 2024. She has two daughters with her ex-husband, Cory Althoff. 
 McCall DaPron, 36 
 Where you might recognize her from: A lifestyle influencer and sourdough baker with a combined 105,000 followers on Instagram and TikTok . She is also the older sister of OG Mormon Wives star Mayci Neeley. 
 Relationship status: DaPron has been married to her husband, Kirk, since 2011. The couple faced backlash last month when they dressed up for Halloween as Jackie Kennedy and President John F. Kennedy on the day of his assassination. 
 Salomé Andrea, 33 
 Where you might recognize her from: A social media influencer with over two million followers across Instagram and TikTok . 
 Relationship status: Andrea has been married to photographer Aaron Brimhall since 2012. They share twin daughters and will soon welcome their third child. 
 Avery Woods, 31 
 Where you might recognize her from: Host of the podcast Cheers! on Alex Cooper's Unwell Network. She is a former pediatric ICU nurse who has since built an online following, with 3.3 million combined followers on Instagram and TikTok . 
 Relationship status: Woods is married to former police officer David Christopher Woods, with whom she shares two children. She also co-parents two children from David's previous relationship. 
 Chandler Higginson, 31
 Where you might recognize her from: Higginson kept a low profile before joining the Mormon Wives cast. 
 Relationship status: She is married to Dylan Higginson, with whom she shares three children. 
 Ashleigh Pease, 32
 Where you might recognize her from: A lifestyle and fitness influencer who has around 12,000 combined followers on Instagram and TikTok . 
 Relationship status: Pease has been married to Nathan Pease since 2013. They share four children. 
 Madison Bontempo, 34
 Where you might recognize her from: A former actress whose credits include Chapel and The Last Straw . She's developed a following as a content creator, with more than 1.8 million followers on Instagram . 
 Relationship status: Bontempo is married to Kyler Steven Fisher, with whom she shares five children.
